nodes.label: gppu.Env
nodes.rationale: Env holds what the app was configured with, not what the app is doing; the app's objects and their state live in the app, never in Env.

nodes.norm_label: lifecycle steps init load start stop

nodes.label: MqttMixin
nodes.rationale: The mqtt library is not a service: each service owns its broker login, identifier, and status/<service> LWT.

nodes.label: gppu.iot - IoT Primitives, MQTT Plumbing & Control Mixins
nodes.norm_label: gppu.iot - iot primitives, mqtt plumbing & control mixins

nodes.label: AppService.from_mqtt
nodes.rationale: Console apps and apps that restart to apply configuration need no background connection for configuration.

nodes.label: config_mqtt topics
nodes.rationale: Destination paths cannot overlap, because delivery order must not decide which configuration wins.

nodes.label: Profile process cleanup
nodes.rationale: A previous run may have left the profile locked or crashed, so the profile is made usable before Chrome starts.

nodes.label: Sidecar manifests
nodes.rationale: Injection needs its own process, so a mode cannot be both inline and injected.

nodes.label: setuptools_scm tag selection
nodes.rationale: It reads gppu/v* tags only so that other modules' tags do not perturb the version.

nodes.label: Files API app
nodes.rationale: Credentials are not stored in these records. A Provider reads them where it declares them.

nodes.label: STATE_GLYPHS
nodes.rationale: One shared set of symbols, so applications do not each choose their own check mark or animation characters.

nodes.label: require_value flag
nodes.rationale: Without it an empty submit and a cancel both return an empty string, so the callback cannot tell them apart.

nodes.label: SPINNERS
nodes.rationale: Variants suit specific layouts: line for narrow columns, arc for dark terminals, triangle for a single focal indicator, pulse for minimal motion per row.

nodes.label: gppu.ld
nodes.rationale: Install fastapi-querybuilder with --no-deps, because its metadata lists poetry, uvicorn and aiosqlite as runtime dependencies.

nodes.label: gppu.tui.config_editor
nodes.rationale: A configuration split across several files can be edited from one place.

nodes.label: gppu.tui.selectors
nodes.rationale: Each picker serves scripts that need one choice from the user and then return to ordinary command-line work.

nodes.label: gppu.tui.sidecar
nodes.rationale: Exposes an existing script as a launcher item without editing the script.

nodes.label: Container.walk
nodes.rationale: gppu owns source access, exclusions, handler readings and archive extraction; the consumer owns persistence, run state and progress.

nodes.label: Flat Location tree API
nodes.rationale: The UI builds one Location control, so the flat tree is not also exposed under a /children resource.

nodes.label: M365 Provider
nodes.rationale: A last-run timestamp must not replace the API's delta protocol.

nodes.label: mark
nodes.rationale: Call only after the widget is mounted, because the table's columns are created in on_mount.
